licensing_rules.subject: Minor-work exemption threshold ($1,000)
licensing_rules.verified_rule: Exempts casual/minor work only when aggregate labor + materials is under $1,000, work is not split across contracts, contractor does not advertise as a contractor or employ helpers, and no building permit is required.
licensing_rules.project_impact: A CSLB-licensed contractor is required for advertised plumbing/drywall trade contractors and multi-trade concealed repairs. Earlier repo citations of '$500' are outdated pre-2026 law.

licensing_rules.subject: General Building Contractor multi-trade authority
licensing_rules.verified_rule: A Class B contractor may take a prime contract involving at least two unrelated building trades/crafts other than framing/carpentry (e.g., plumbing + drywall/painting), or self-perform plumbing directly when holding C-36.
licensing_rules.project_impact: Dual B + C-36 licensees (#829071, #1025814, #959843, #1003394, #1115649, #841229) can lawfully execute both the plumbing repair and storage-ceiling drywall restoration under a single contract.

licensing_rules.code: 16 CCR Div. 8 Art. 3 — CSLB Class C-36
licensing_rules.subject: Plumbing Contractor specialty scope
licensing_rules.verified_rule: Covers potable water supply and fluid waste disposal piping, venting, valves, fixtures, and waste-system maintenance/replacement.
licensing_rules.project_impact: C-36-only plumbers (#977638, #757796, #1024971) may replace the bathtub waste-and-overflow assembly, but cannot take a standalone drywall restoration contract without subcontracting or pairing with a C-9/B licensee.

licensing_rules.code: 16 CCR Div. 8 Art. 3 — CSLB Class C-9
licensing_rules.subject: Drywall Contractor specialty scope
licensing_rules.verified_rule: Covers layout and installation of gypsum wallboard assemblies, nonstructural framing, taping, compounds, and smooth/textured surface finishing.
licensing_rules.project_impact: Covers storage-unit ceiling gypsum board replacement, taping, mudding, and texture matching (e.g., Bernal Hill Drywall Inc #995163 holds C-9 + B).

licensing_rules.subject: Class B-2 Residential Remodeling Contractor limits
licensing_rules.verified_rule: Requires 3+ unrelated trades in a residential wood-frame structure and prohibits installing, replacing, or substantially altering plumbing systems/mechanisms unless holding C-36 or subcontracting to C-36.
licensing_rules.project_impact: A B-2 contractor without C-36 cannot self-perform full concealed waste-and-overflow replacement.

licensing_rules.subject: Mandatory $25,000 bond, Workers' Comp, and deposit cap
licensing_rules.verified_rule: Active CA contractors must maintain a $25,000 license bond, carry Workers' Compensation if employing workers, and cannot demand a down payment exceeding 10% of contract price or $1,000, whichever is less.
licensing_rules.project_impact: Protects property owner in occupied-unit work; verify COI + WC policy if more than the sole owner arrives on site.

technical_rows.component: Faceplate Trip Lever, Cotter Pin & Clevis (#10700 / #10930 / #10950)
technical_rows.mechanism: External lever pivots on overflow faceplate and raises/lowers internal brass eye-bolt and 5.25 in. double-loop wire linkage.
technical_rows.failure_risk: If clevis or cotter pin disconnects or wire kinks inside the 1.5 in. overflow tube, moving the handle no longer lifts the drop cylinder.
technical_rows.access_implication: Inspectable from above by removing the two 2.25 in. overflow faceplate screws — zero wall/ceiling opening required for initial inspection.

technical_rows.component: Hollow Brass Drop Cylinder / Plunger Barrel (#41005)
technical_rows.mechanism: Hollow cylindrical brass barrel travels vertically down the overflow riser to seat inside the sanitary waste tee cavity while allowing excess overflow water through its hollow core.
technical_rows.failure_risk: Mineral scale, corrosion/dezincification, hair/soap calcified buildup, or solvent-cement/solder burr inside the waste tee seizes the barrel firmly in the concealed tee.
technical_rows.access_implication: Excessive upward pulling torque from above transfers directly into aged 17g/20g tubular brass slip nuts or brittle soldered/galvanized tee joints behind the closed wall.
technical_rows.official_source_label: Oatey Dearborn Bath Waste & Watco Instructions

technical_rows.component: Overflow Elbow, Sponge Gasket & Retainer Plate (#44003 / #40675 / #11530)
technical_rows.mechanism: Overflow elbow presses a foam/rubber gasket against the exterior back wall of the tub, held only by retainer plate screws through the tub overflow hole.
technical_rows.failure_risk: If forceful top-side prying shifts or cracks the concealed overflow elbow or dislodges its rear gasket, water leaks invisibly into the wall/ceiling cavity during deep baths.
technical_rows.access_implication: Explains why 5+ plumbers declined blind high-force extraction without rear/under-tub visual access.

technical_rows.component: Stage 1 Protocol — Controlled Top-Side Diagnostic Only
technical_rows.mechanism: Remove faceplate screws, inspect linkage/cotter pin with borescope, apply safe penetrating descaler only if linkage is intact, and enforce a strict no-force stop rule.
technical_rows.failure_risk: Low risk ONLY when torque is capped; immediately abort top-side extraction if barrel does not slide freely by hand tension.
technical_rows.access_implication: Preserves tenant bathroom tile/tub completely and avoids unnecessary ceiling opening if only upper cotter-pin/linkage is detached.

technical_rows.component: Stage 2 Protocol — Surgical Storage-Ceiling Access, Toe-Touch Upgrade & Open Leak Test
technical_rows.mechanism: Cut clean square access opening in unoccupied storage-unit gypsum ceiling below tub, replace entire concealed waste-and-overflow assembly, convert to modern Toe-Touch/Uni-Lift stopper (eliminating internal trip-lever linkage permanently), fill tub to overflow to visually inspect every joint behind tub, then patch/tape/texture drywall ceiling.
technical_rows.failure_risk: Eliminates hidden leak risk and prevents future stuck-barrel recurrence; dust/debris is isolated primarily to the storage room below rather than the occupied apartment.
technical_rows.access_implication: Requires B + C-36 contractor (or C-36 plumber + C-9 drywall specialist); consider installing a rated ceiling access panel or Level 4/5 gypsum patch per building fire/finish requirements.

flags.title: No-employee Workers' Compensation exemptions on GeneralSF (#959843), Rapid Flow (#1115649), Bay Area Plumbing (#757796), and Manny's (#841229)
flags.detail: Official CSLB records as of 11/7/2026 show these four active licensees certified they have no employees and are therefore exempt from Workers' Compensation insurance.
